title: PC® Sumatra Single Origin Dark Roast Whole Bean Coffee
description:
Mad about a midnight-dark cup? This 100% arabica coffee from Sumatra is best served black. This coffee is Rainforest Alliance certified* and was grown at at an elevation between 800 and 1,500 metres—at higher elevations, it takes longer for coffee cherry fruit to mature, resulting in more complex sugars and deeper, more subtle flavours. Why buy whole bean? Coffee’s natural oils contribute to the taste and aroma inside the whole bean. If you love the full sensory experience of black coffee, whole beans are for you. Dark roasted to perfection in Canada to bring out this coffee’s spicy, earthy cocoa notes, it comes packed in our award-winning, recyclable packaging**.

Brew tip: Grinding whole beans gives you the freedom to brew how you prefer—filter, drip, cold brew, French press—your pick!

*The Rainforest Alliance supports sustainable coffee farming practices. Learn more at www.ra.org.**Our recyclable packaging is made with a minimum 80% paper content—freshness seal is not recyclable.

title: Calorie-Free Sweetener from the Stevia Leaf Spoonable Jar

This gives you the white crystals you're used to without the calories. The lid opens to allow for measuring spoons to scoop up the sweetness you need when cooking. title: Calorie-Free Sweetener from the Stevia Leaf Sachets/Packets

We believe sweetness was meant to be enjoyed. That's why we created products that allow you to reduce sugar, not flavour. The clean, sweet flavour contained in Truvia Calorie-Free Sweetener sachets/packets comes from nature in the form of the stevia leaf. Leaves don't dissolve well in beverages or baked goods, so we extract the sweetness from the stevia leaf. Because stevia leaf extract is 200x sweeter than sugar, we balance the sweetness with erythritol, a sweetener produced by fermentation. Erythritol is also found in fruits like grapes and pears. This gives you the white crystals you're used to without the calories. This 80-count box is just the right size to fit on your counter or in your pantry.
